title: DENR urges protection of rare Atimonan Spikemoss in Quezon

blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) has urged the public to help protect the Atimonan Spikemoss (Selaginella atimonanensis), a rare plant species found exclusively in the Quezon Protected Landscape (QPL) in Quezon province. Spikemoss grows on steep limestone cliffs deep within the QPL. “Every plant in our protected areas plays a role in keeping our ecosystems resilient,” the DENR in Calabarzon said. “This particular species is endemic to Calabarzon — meaning it exists naturally right here in our region and nowhere else on Earth,” it added.
